expectations.text: The output identifies at least 2 ambiguities or gaps in the design doc before generating tasks
expectations.evidence: Identified 10 specific ambiguities: log format specifics, 'large files efficiently' definition, pattern detection algorithm, time window definition, report output format, CLI framework, time range filter format, error identification, exit codes, Python version/packaging

expectations.text: The output explicitly states assumptions made for unresolved ambiguities
expectations.evidence: Listed 10 explicit assumptions matching each ambiguity: RFC 3164 + JSON Lines, stream line-by-line, template-based patterns, fixed 5-min windows, plain text + JSON, argparse, ISO 8601, ERROR/CRITICAL/FATAL, exit codes 0/1/2, Python 3.10+

expectations.text: Task files are actually generated (not just questions asked)
Each task file has a Test Plan section
expectations.evidence: Cannot verify from summary — task descriptions are one-line summaries without visible section headers

expectations.text: Produces a reasonable number of tasks (3-7 for a CLI tool of this scope)

eval_feedback.overall: Strong performance on ambiguity detection — the skill's key differentiator for this eval.
